segments.text: Stop letting your AI agents dump messy HTML into your context window. It burns thousands of API tokens instantly. You
need Open CLI. It magically converts literally any website into a clean command line interface. It uses your actual signed Chrome session, so there
is zero login hassle. You get exactly the data you need while cutting token usage by 93%. It even controls desktop
